newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Atacocha soars 10.1 pct on bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Atacocha soars 10.1 pct on bolsa.

text.p: The share price of Atacocha soared 10.1 percent by late trade Tuesday on the Lima Stock Exchange due to high zinc prices and the miner's cost-cutting program to reduce its workforce, brokers said.
Atacocha has gained 46 percent this month as it has led the mining sector's bull run.
Another polymetallic miner, Morococha, also rose strongly in Tuesday's trade, gaining 7.53 percent to 4.00 soles in volume of 330,000 shares.

Brokers said Morococha's rise was due to last week's announcement that Phelps Dodge Corp had bought a 27 percent stake in the firm. High international zinc prices and the Phelps buy have pushed the miner 44 percent higher in May.

The rises "are directly due to the price of zinc that will be reflected in the companies' profits so that their second quarter financial results are expected to be better," said Guillermo Siles of local brokerage Argos.
Miners -- especially zinc producers -- have dominated the Lima bolsa this year.
